subject: Re: Commercial structuring for ClearMap - onboarding credit & support options
messages:
From: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@clearmaphealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Li <marcus.li@clearmaphealth.com>, procurement@clearmaphealth.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial ask - onboarding credit and support tiering

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for yesterday's technical session — the demo helped a lot. We're close to an internal decision but have two commercial asks we need to resolve before procurement signs off:

1) Onboarding credit — our CFO is pushing for a one-time onboarding credit to offset migration costs (data transfer, compliance verification and the engineering runway). We're looking at something in the ~$75k-125k range depending on commitment.
2) Support tier flexibility — we want to start at a Standard SLA with a clear path to upgrade to Enterprise SRE within 6 months. Can you confirm a staging/upgrade price cadence and whether platform fee can be amortized over the committed term?

Can you share a concrete path (numbers + timing) and the documents procurement needs to process a PO?

Appreciate it — Sophie
Sophie Tan
VP, Technology Operations
ClearMap Health

[Attachment: migration-readiness-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@clearmaphealth.com>, Marcus Li <marcus.li@clearmaphealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial ask - onboarding credit and support tiering

Hi Sophie — great to hear the demo was useful. High level options below; happy to jump on a quick call to walk through numbers.

Option A — One-time onboarding credit:
- Credit: $75,000 applied against first invoice (covers migration support and 2 weeks of dedicated onboarding SRE hours).
- Commit: 12-month minimum term, standard platform fee applies.
- Limit: Credit applied only once and tied to invoice milestone on go-live.

Option B — Pilot-first concession:
- 50% discount on platform fee for first 3 months + $35,000 onboarding credit.
- Commit: pilot-to-production cadence with 12-month renewal on conversion.

Support tiering:
- Start: Standard Support (24/5) with optional SRE add-on blocks priced at $12k / month.
- Upgrade: Upgrade to Enterprise SRE within 3–6 months by executing a support amendment; we can amortize an uplift to the platform fee across the remaining committed term on conversion.

Procurement checklist (what we'll provide):
- Signed SOW (I attach a draft)
- Commercial addendum with credit language (legal will mark up)
- Link to DocuSign for PO and SOW

I've attached SOW_v1 for your review. If you prefer, we can structure a capped onboarding credit of $100k instead of the two-option approach; I need internal approvals for amounts >$75k.

Next steps: if Option A is acceptable, I can loop in legal (Irene) and finalize a short commercial addendum.

Best,
Priya
Account Executive — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: ClearMap_SOW_v1.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: ClearMap commercial posture

Priya — quick internal note before we send final to ClearMap.

Context: they asked for $75–125k. We should be willing to offer up to $75k vanilla credit without exec sign-off; anything above needs approval plus justification vs pipeline compression. Proposed play:
- Offer $75k onboarding credit tied to go-live invoice.
- Add 10% recurring platform fee discount for first 6 months (helpful to bridge CFO concerns without full price concession).
- Support: keep Standard + $12k/mo SRE blocks, but give 1 month of SRE (equivalent to $12k) included as part of the onboarding credit to make it feel like higher value.

Ask Irene: please prepare a one-page commercial addendum that:
- Defines the credit application milestone;
- Caps liability on SLA credits for the pilot window;
- Leaves upgrade mechanics to an amendment (no immediate price lock).

If Jonas is comfortable, we can approve $75k + 10% x 6mo discount as standard counter.

-Marissa

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 18:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: ClearMap commercial posture (redlines attached)

Thanks — attached is a clean commercial addendum that implements Marissa's posture. Key points:
- Onboarding credit: flat one-time credit of $75,000 applied to first invoice after go-live; credit extinguishes after invoice application.
- Support: include one complimentary 4-week SRE engagement (documented as "onboarding services") charged against the credit; subsequent SRE blocks billed at $12,000/mo.
- Amortization: we include an optional clause that allows platform fee uplift to be amortized over remaining committed months if they upgrade to Enterprise mid-term.
- SLA credits: add a negotiated cap during pilot (limit to 25% of monthly fee for pilot months) — protects us from outsized exposure.

I redlined the SOW in ClearMap_MAL_redlines.docx and produced Commercial_Addendum_Clean.pdf. If approved, I recommend we send with a short covering email and DocuSign link.

-Irene
General Counsel, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: ClearMap_MAL_redlines.docx]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@clearmaphealth.com>, Marcus Li <marcus.li@clearmaphealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, procurement@clearmaphealth.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Final commercial proposal and docs (SOW + addendum)

Hi Sophie — thanks for the patience. Based on our internal review, here is the agreed counter we can move to signature on:

- One-time onboarding credit: $75,000 applied to the first post-go-live invoice.
- Introductory platform concession: 10% off platform fee for first 6 months post-go-live.
- Onboarding services: include one 4-week dedicated SRE engagement (documented in SOW) charged against the $75k credit.
- Support upgrade: you can upgrade to Enterprise SRE anytime; any platform fee uplift can be amortized evenly across the remaining committed months on conversion.
- Commercial/legal: attached Clean Commercial Addendum and redlined SOW. SLA credit cap applied during pilot months as discussed.

Next steps for procurement:
1) Review attached Commercial_Addendum_Clean.pdf and SOW — I included DocuSign links below.
2) If acceptable, sign the addendum + SOW in DocuSign and issue a PO referencing deal CLMP-2027-01.
3) We will schedule the onboarding SRE engagement within 2 weeks of signature.

DocuSign (SOW + Addendum): https://na1.docusign.net/CLMP-2027-SOW
Redwood SOW (preview): https://app.redwood.com/docs/SOW/CLMP-2027-01

If you'd like an in-person walkthrough for the CFO or procurement team, I'm happy to set up a 30-minute call.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: ClearMap_SOW_v1.pdf, Commercial_Addendum_Clean.pdf]

From: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@clearmaphealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Li <marcus.li@clearmaphealth.com>, procurement@clearmaphealth.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final commercial proposal and docs (SOW + addendum)

Thanks, Priya — this looks good and pragmatic. I'll run the addendum and SOW by our CFO this afternoon. If all green, we'll sign via DocuSign and issue a PO by end of week. Appreciate the flexibility on the upgrade amortization — that helps.

Talk soon,
Sophie
VP, Technology Operations
ClearMap Health
